narrative.offerRewardText: I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. Thank you, adventurer. I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken soon enough.

quests.objectiveText: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

quests.name: Seeping Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.
